title: Aircraft exhaust · native gas fields
field_note: Native cell values on the 13,472-cell 2D gas mesh. The aircraft and ground are boundary surfaces; their solid temperatures were not solved. Display range is fixed; values outside it saturate. Click a cell to plot its saved-time history.
source_note: R5 native OpenFOAM fields; 0.1 m computational span, 61 snapshots, 0–15 s. A hypothetical, nonreacting release; no mesh/time-step independence or safety qualification.
